vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: audio-gen
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is classified as suspicious due to the direct execution of a shell command (`uv run ...`) instructed within `SKILL.md`. While this command targets a local Python script (`/home/clawdbot/clawdbot/skills/sag/scripts/tts.py`) and appears to be for the legitimate purpose of text-to-speech generation, it represents a high-risk capability (arbitrary command execution) without the full context of the `tts.py` script itself. There is no clear evidence of intentional malicious behavior like data exfiltration or persistence, and prompt injection attempts are not present; however, the direct shell access elevates it beyond benign.
